findings.description: `PERMALINK` takes the ref as a single segment (`[\w.-]+\/`). A link to a branch or tag whose name contains `/` (e.g. `feature/x`, `release/1.2`) is only partly stripped. Example: `https://github.com/acme/tool/blob/feature/x/src/claude/hooks.ts` becomes `x/src/claude/hooks.ts`. That path matches no ADR glob, and `moduleOf` returns undefined for it. So a bug whose Suspected area is that link gets `triggers: []` and `needsDesign: false`, while the bare `src/claude/hooks.ts` fires `adr-area`. This breaks the acceptance criterion "permalink matches same globs as bare path" for a realistic input, and the gate passes when it should fire. Before this PR the link didn't match either. The fault is in the new feature, not a regression.
findings.body:
[`PERMALINK`](https://github.com/AlexisBalayre/pupitre/blob/15a0526721827190e0cd671af74c3b4bdd311380/src/core/ticket-intake.utils.ts#L110-L111) reads exactly one segment as the ref. Many branch and tag names contain `/` (`feature/x`, `release/1.2`), and GitHub writes their URLs as-is: `https://github.com/acme/tool/blob/feature/x/src/claude/hooks.ts`. The strip then leaves `x/src/claude/hooks.ts`. That path matches no ADR glob (`globToRegExp` anchors with `^…$`, so `src/claude/**` and `src/claude/hooks.ts` both miss), the new prefix arm is false, and `moduleOf` reads no module from it. A bug ticket with that Suspected area gets `triggers: []` / `needsDesign: false`, while the bare path fires `adr-area`. That breaks the PR's acceptance criterion "A GitHub permalink in the area matches the same ADR globs as the bare path" for a URL copied from a branch view, and it errs toward *not* firing.

The ref can't be split from the path without knowing the repo's refs. To keep "erring toward firing", the permalink case could test every suffix of the remainder after `/(blob|tree)/` as a candidate path for `inAdrArea`. A path that names a real repo directory deep inside another one is unlikely, so over-firing should stay rare. Add a test with a slash ref (`blob/feature/x/src/claude/hooks.ts`).

findings.description: PERMALINK is anchored at `^github\.com` and only knows `blob`/`tree`, so `www.github.com/...` links and `.../blame/<ref>/...` links (common in bug reports) stay unstripped and still miss the ADR globs their bare path hits; `/^(?:www\.)?github\.com\/[\w.-]+\/[\w.-]+\/(?:blob|tree|blame)\/[\w.-]+\//` would cover both.
